source_of_truth: The canonical IAB source file is authoritative. Line citations refer to the helper source file used for structured extraction.

fields.name: bcat
fields.type_spec: string array categories. Refer to List 5.1.

fields.name: bapp
fields.type_spec: string array independent application identifiers. On Android, these should be bundle or package names (e.g., com.foo.mygame). On iOS, these are numeric IDs.

fields.name: regs
fields.type_spec: object or governmental regulations in force for this request.

fields.name: id
fields.type_spec: string Banner objects are used with a Video object (Section 3.2.4) to represent an array of companion ads. Values usually start at 1 and increase with each object; should be unique within an impression.

fields.name: api
fields.type_spec: integer array List 5.6. If an API is not explicitly listed, it is assumed not to be supported.

fields.name: dealid
fields.type_spec: string pertains to a private marketplace direct deal.

fields.name: exp
fields.type_spec: integer wait between the auction and the actual impression.
